scoreDefinitions.health: Health Score averages turn-two access to each required color or hybrid alternative group. It does not measure simultaneous payment or spell castability.
scoreDefinitions.blueprint: Blueprint Stability combines Health (40%), land-ratio balance around 40% lands (20%), turn-two color access (25%) and turn-four color access (15%).
scoreDefinitions.mulligan: Mulligan scores simulated opening hands using archetype weights. They differ from deck-level Health and Blueprint Stability.
scoreDefinitions.limitation: These are heuristic indices, not win probabilities or guaranteed keep decisions.

assumptions.note: Saved lands-only potential, not interactive Castability settings.

colorAccessNotes: Color access score unavailable: a main-deck payment uses unrepresented symbols (such as phyrexian or snow). See individual castability limitations.
